summary.text: A caller enters Dashboard.requestRefresh with a place ID. Dashboard URL-encodes the ID in a bodyless POST /places/{id}/refresh with a 10-second timeout; the saved Dashboard-to-Places mapping is agent-proposed, so runtime routing is unverified. Places.Refresh calls Find; Find returns the first ID match from List. If no place is found, Refresh returns 404 PLACE_NOT_FOUND before enqueue. Otherwise it awaits Enqueue, which opens a connection, begins a transaction, inserts a request_outbox row with a new GUID and a place.requested v1 payload, then commits before Refresh returns 202 with status QUEUED. QUEUED marks the response, not forecast completion. Dashboard forwards upstream status and parsed JSON; a fetch or JSON-decoding exception becomes 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE, which does not show whether Places committed first. Open disposes and rethrows on connection-open failure; other exception-to-HTTP handling is outside these bodies. The saved process links separate Places publisher and Dashboard/Forecasts consumer views, but this path does not establish publication or delivery. These wrappers show no idempotency key or repeated-request deduplication.
